stem: Which statement about g(x) = x^2 - 576 is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The zeros, -288 and 288, can be found when 0 = (x + 288)(x - 288).

options.label: G
options.text: The only zero, 288, can be found when 0 = (x - 288)^2.

options.label: H
options.text: The zeros, -24 and 24, can be found when 0 = (x + 24)(x - 24).

options.label: J
options.text: The only zero, 24, can be found when 0 = (x - 24)^2.
